seoTitle: Kansas City Public Schools Calendar: KCPS Dates & PDFs
seoDescription: Reviewed Kansas City Public Schools calendars with key dates, school breaks, student days off, quarter dates, early dismissal, and official multilingual PDFs.
districtFact: Kansas City Public Schools says 64 languages are spoken across the district. KCPS publishes its 2026–27 school calendar in English, Spanish, and Swahili, making the translated editions part of the district's family calendar access rather than separate academic schedules.

about.title: One KCPS Schedule, Three Language Editions
about.content: KCPS publishes English, Spanish, and Swahili calendar PDFs for 2026–27. Four reporting dates in the current English edition differ from the translated files, so this site follows the English calendar and documents the differences. Individual schools may publish additional events, bell times, and activities.

about.title: Some KCPS Student Days Off Run Together
about.content: The district calendar places parent-teacher conferences next to a PD day in October and a PD/workday in February before Presidents' Day. Reading the official labels together helps families identify longer childcare windows that are easy to miss in a month grid.

about.title: Senior and Districtwide Last Days Are Different
about.content: KCPS lists April 30 as the seniors' last day. The last day for students districtwide is May 28, when schools dismiss early and report cards are available. The calendar does not publish one districtwide dismissal time for that date.

calendarNotes: KCPS publishes quarter boundaries, progress-report and report-card dates, parent-teacher conference closures, district professional-development days, major breaks, a separate senior last day, and a last day for students with early dismissal. The annual PDF does not state a total instructional-day count, so this site does not infer one.

planningTips.title: Planning Notes for KCPS Families
content: Use your school's calendar for campus events and bell times; the district PDF is the districtwide planning schedule.
Plan for October 29–30 and February 11–15 as connected student days off even though KCPS uses several official labels across those dates.
Students return from Winter Break on January 5 because January 4 is a district professional-development day with no school.
Treat April 30 as the seniors' last day, not the last day for every KCPS student.
Check your school for the May 28 early-dismissal time because the district calendar does not print one universal time.

districtFaqs.q: When does Kansas City Public Schools start in 2026?
districtFaqs.a: The KCPS 2026–27 calendar lists Monday, August 24, 2026, as the first day for students.

districtFaqs.q: Does KCPS publish its school calendar in other languages?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. KCPS publishes official 2026–27 calendar PDFs in English, Spanish, and Swahili. Four reporting dates in the current English edition differ from the translated PDFs; the calendar page documents those differences.

districtFaqs.q: Do KCPS students return from Winter Break on January 4, 2027?
districtFaqs.a: No. January 4 is a district professional-development day with no school. Students return Tuesday, January 5.

districtFaqs.q: When is the last day for KCPS seniors in 2027?
districtFaqs.a: The calendar lists Friday, April 30, 2027, as the seniors' last day. May 28 is the last day for all KCPS students.

districtFaqs.q: What time does KCPS dismiss on the last day of school?
districtFaqs.a: May 28, 2027, is an early-dismissal day, but the district PDF does not give one districtwide dismissal time. Families should check their school's schedule.
